company.name: Coinpath
company.description: A budgeting app with a debit card. Every card payment shows up instantly and is sorted into budgets. Coinpath Premium adds savings goals and cashback.

title: Coinpath: a month of feedback
brief: Coinpath's inbox for the last 30 days holds 62 pieces of feedback: app reviews, support tickets and NPS comments. The PM who used to triage it has left, and the team plans the next quarter on Monday. Group the feedback into themes, set the noise aside, flag anything critical, rank the themes by what matters, and write opportunities for the top ones.

themes.label: Card payments are charged twice
themes.summary: A retry in the card processor duplicates some payments, and the money really leaves the account. It is a regulatory and trust incident: people cannot pay rent with money they do not have.
themes.opportunity: How might we stop duplicate charges today, refund every affected customer automatically and tell them before they notice?

themes.label: People cannot log in
themes.summary: Password resets, verification codes and social sign-in fail, and people are locked out of their own data. Every one of these users is fully blocked.
themes.opportunity: How might we make sure nobody stays locked out of Coinpath, with sign-in and recovery that work on the first try?

themes.label: The app got slow
themes.summary: Load times and responsiveness got worse over recent releases. It annoys everyone a little and pushes some people away, but nobody is blocked.
themes.opportunity: How might we make opening Coinpath and loading transactions feel instant again, with a load-time budget every release has to meet?

themes.label: The price feels too high
themes.summary: Complaints about the price and the last increase. Loud and frequent, but people still use the product; it is a positioning question, not a broken experience.
themes.opportunity: How might we make the value of Coinpath Premium obvious before renewal, so the price feels earned?

themes.label: Support is slow
themes.summary: Slow or unhelpful support. It multiplies the pain of every other problem, but it is a symptom as much as a cause.
themes.opportunity: How might we answer the most common questions before people need to contact us, and reply to the rest within a day?

themes.label: Requests for shared budgets with a partner
themes.summary: A popular request. It signals what people want next, but its absence does not hurt anyone today.
themes.opportunity: How might we find out which job shared budgets with a partner would do for people, and whether a smaller version solves it?

themes.label: Upsells are pushy
themes.summary: Upgrade prompts feel aggressive. It erodes goodwill, but nobody is blocked.
themes.opportunity: How might we show Coinpath Premium at the moment someone needs it, instead of on every screen?

hidden.explanation: The critical problem, "Card payments are charged twice", appears in only 4 items, all from the last 6 days. Few items, but each describes harm that grows every day it stays live, so it goes first whatever the volume. Volume alone would put "The price feels too high" next, with 13 items, but it is a low-severity problem. "People cannot log in" (7 items, high severity) and "The app got slow" (9 items, medium severity) hurt more people more. Impact here is reach times severity: low counts 1, medium 2, high 3 per item. 8 items were noise: praise, spam and off-topic messages that belong in no theme.
hidden.principle: Rank feedback by reach times severity, not by volume, and read the rare, recent and severe items first: a critical problem is usually quiet before it gets loud.
